metadata.dcterms:title: FROM STATE INTEGRALS TO q-SERIES
metadata.dcterms:creator: ALIDIS, STA VROS GAROUF
KASHAEV, RINAT
metadata.dcterms:abstract: It is well-known to the experts that multi-dimensional state integra ls of prod- ucts of Faddeev’s quantum dilogarithm which arise in Quantum Topolog y can be written as ﬁnite sums of products of basic hypergeometric series in q = e2πiτ and ˜q = e− 2πi/τ . We illustrate this fact by giving a detailed proof for a family of one-dimens ional integrals which includes state-integral invariants of 4 1 and 5 2 knots.
